# Registration

The event is **free and open to all**, but **registration is required**.  
Please complete the registration form **at least one day before the event**.  

Participant lists are processed regularly, so please allow a **few days for confirmation**.  
Once processed, you will receive a **Microsoft Teams invitation** by email.  

If you register late, or if you have **not received your invitation two days before the event**,  
please contact us at [hsi@incose.org](mailto:hsi@incose.org).

---
